[[Delta-class JV-7 escort shuttle]] '''''Cateb''''' was an [[Airam (group)|Airam]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]]. It was present at [[Goff Platform]], where it was destroyed during [[Attack on Goff|the Imperial attack there]] along with the rest of the defense force.
